exporter_binary_identity.attribution_basis: Unique loaded Excel-process module whose ModuleName matches VBE[0-9]*.DLL.
exporter_binary_identity.claim_scope: Exact loaded VBE binary identity; this does not independently prove which binary owns VBComponent.Export.

binary.path_resolution_caveat: The loaded module path was not directly readable; bytes were hashed from the unique deterministic Click-to-Run VFS backing path under the frozen Excel Office root.

geometry_result.basis: Excel 16.0.20131.20112 MSForms ListBox normalized the requested 60.0-point height to this deterministic readback after control initialization.
